<link rel="canonical" href="https://www.thatlayover.life/">
<style id="tll-home-search-v3">
/* 2026-09-23: the search bar drew two pills. The site-level prototype rule styles form.tll-home-search as the pill,
   and the Webflow form wrapper (.w-form) drew the same border around it. Wrapper goes flat; the form keeps the pill.
   If the class-adding script never runs, the wrapper keeps its own pill, so no-JS still renders one clean bar. */
.w-form:has(> form.tll-home-search){background:transparent !important;border:0 !important;border-radius:0 !important;padding:0 !important;box-shadow:none !important;display:block !important}
form.tll-home-search{max-width:none;width:100%;gap:10px;padding:6px 6px 6px 22px}
form.tll-home-search input[type=text]{font-size:16px;height:46px}
form.tll-home-search input[type=text]::placeholder{color:#6B6660}
/* Teal on a light surface is #067A79, not #00C9C8 */
form.tll-home-search input[type=submit]{background:#067A79 !important;color:#fff !important;height:46px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:26px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.4px;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .15s ease}
form.tll-home-search input[type=submit]:hover{background:#05605F !important}
form.tll-home-search input[type=submit]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #F0507A;outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:560px){form.tll-home-search{padding-left:16px}form.tll-home-search input[type=submit]{padding:0 16px;font-size:12px}}
</style>
<style id="tll-home-search-mobile-v4">
/* 2026-09-29: under 600px the site-wide craft-polish rule sets every .w-input to width:100% !important, which starved the
   search input inside the flex pill and let the Search button fill the whole bar. Pin the input and button widths here. */
@media(max-width:600px){
form:has(> #Search-the-library),form.tll-home-search{display:flex !important;flex-wrap:nowrap !important;align-items:center !important;gap:6px !important;padding:5px 5px 5px 14px !important}
#Search-the-library,form.tll-home-search input[type=text]{width:auto !important;flex:1 1 auto !important;min-width:0 !important;height:42px !important;font-size:16px !important}
form:has(> #Search-the-library) input[type=submit],form.tll-home-search input[type=submit]{width:auto !important;flex:0 0 auto !important;height:42px !important;min-height:0 !important;padding:0 16px !important;font-size:12px !important;line-height:42px !important}
}
</style>
<script id="tll-home-search-placeholder-v1">
/* 2026-09-29: the Designer API cannot set a placeholder, and the site script only rewrites one that already starts with "Search". Set it here. */
(function(){function p(){var i=document.getElementById('Search-the-library');if(i&&!i.getAttribute('placeholder'))i.setAttribute('placeholder','Search a country, a layover, a feeling…');}
if(document.readyState!=='loading')p();else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',p);})();
</script>
<style id="tll-flow-v1">
/* TLL long-scroll layer v1 (30 Sep 2026, Readymag brief). Additive: no element removed, no binding touched. Kit v2.1 tokens only. */
[data-tll-flow="hero"]{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}
[data-tll-flow="hero"] h1{font-size:clamp(46px,8.4vw,132px)!important;line-height:.96!important;letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:12ch}
.tll-flow-ticker{border-top:1px solid #23263c;border-bottom:1px solid #23263c;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding:12px 0;background:#0A0B14}
.tll-flow-ticker .t{display:inline-block;animation:tllTick 50s linear infinite}
.tll-flow-ticker span{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#00C9C8;margin-right:40px}
@keyframes tllTick{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.tll-flow-man{position:relative;height:240vh;background:#FDF9F3;color:#1A1A1A}
.tll-flow-man .pin{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.tll-flow-man .l{position:absolute;left:24px;right:24px;font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(40px,8vw,128px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.02em;opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);margin:0}
.tll-flow-man .l em{font-style:italic;color:#F0507A}.tll-flow-man .l.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
.tll-flow-man .c{position:absolute;left:24px;top:32px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#067A79}
.tll-flow-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .52s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform .52s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.tll-flow-reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
[data-tll-flow="section"] h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,84px)!important;line-height:1.02!important;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.tll-flow-rail{position:fixed;right:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:30;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;align-items:flex-end}
.tll-flow-rail a{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;color:#7d7f96;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;mix-blend-mode:difference}
.tll-flow-rail a::after{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.tll-flow-rail a.on{color:#F0507A}.tll-flow-rail a span{opacity:0;transition:opacity .16s}.tll-flow-rail a.on span,.tll-flow-rail:hover a span{opacity:1}
@media(max-width:900px){.tll-flow-rail{display:none}.tll-flow-man{height:auto}.tll-flow-man .pin{height:auto;display:block;padding:72px 24px}.tll-flow-man .l{position:static;opacity:1;transform:none;margin:0 0 12px}.tll-flow-man .c{display:none}}
.tll-atlas{background:#FDF9F3;color:#1A1A1A;padding:80px 24px 0}
.tll-atlas .in{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto}
.tll-atlas .e{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;color:#067A79}
.tll-atlas h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,84px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:14ch;margin:10px 0 0;color:#1A1A1A}
.tll-atlas p{color:#6B6660;max-width:52ch;margin:14px 0 30px}
.tll-atlas .list{columns:3;column-gap:32px;border-top:1px solid #E0DACE}
@media(max-width:800px){.tll-atlas .list{columns:1}}
.tll-atlas .k{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #E0DACE;break-inside:avoid;text-decoration:none;color:#1A1A1A}
.tll-atlas .k .n{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:20px}
.tll-atlas .k .s{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6B6660;white-space:nowrap}
.tll-atlas .k.has .n{color:#C8325B}.tll-atlas .k.has .s{color:#067A79}
.tll-atlas .k:hover .n{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:#00C9C8;text-underline-offset:3px}
.tll-atlas .more{padding:40px 0 60px;text-align:center;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6B6660}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tll-flow-ticker .t{animation:none}.tll-flow-reveal,.tll-flow-man .l{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}.tll-flow-man{height:auto}.tll-flow-man .pin{height:auto;position:static;display:block;padding:72px 24px}.tll-flow-man .l{position:static;margin:0 0 12px}}
</style>
<style id="tll-home-hero-cap-v1">
/* 6 Oct 2026 (Nancy): the hero title stays at the left edge of the container and clear of the boat in the photo. 118px cap, 760px max width:
   "Find your next" ends around 55% of the width at 1920 and 46% at 1440; the boat starts near 61%. Two lines at every width. */
.tllp-home h1:not(.tll-story-title){font-size:clamp(46px,6.4vw,118px) !important;max-width:min(78vw,760px) !important}
</style>
<script id="tll-live-writers-v1">
/* Live writer count (8 Oct 2026). The "Doors opening" heading used to be typed: "One writer so far." It now counts the
   published contributor profiles in /sitemap.xml, the same way the story count works, so no number is hardcoded.
   Zero profiles leaves the heading alone. Cached once per visit in sessionStorage. */
(function(){
var W=['','One','Two','Three','Four','Five','Six','Seven','Eight','Nine','Ten','Eleven','Twelve'];
function apply(n){var w=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT),t;while(t=w.nextNode()){var s=t.nodeValue;if(/^\s*(\w+) writers? so far\./.test(s)){t.nodeValue=s.replace(/^(\s*)(\w+) writers? so far\./,'$1'+(n<W.length?W[n]:String(n))+(n===1?' writer':' writers')+' so far.');}}}
function run(){var c=0;try{c=+sessionStorage.getItem('tllWriterN')||0;}catch(e){}if(c){apply(c);return;}
fetch('/sitemap.xml',{cache:'no-cache'}).then(function(r){return r.text();}).then(function(x){var m=x.match(/<loc>[^<]*\/contributors\/[^<]+<\/loc>/g);var n=m?m.length:0;if(!n)return;try{sessionStorage.setItem('tllWriterN',String(n));}catch(e){}apply(n);}).catch(function(){});}
if(document.readyState!=='loading')run();else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',run);
})();
</script>

<script>
/* TLL Home honesty pass v1 (2026-07-03): Lounge tile initials are Nancy's own photos (NC) or Magnus's (MW);
   crew open-slot avatar letters become +. Raw markup relabeled separately; this covers stragglers. */
(function(){
  function fix(){
    [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("span,div")).forEach(function(e){
      if(e.children.length)return;var t=e.textContent.trim();
      if(["JP","SD","AL","TR","RO"].indexOf(t)>-1&&e.closest("a[href*='gallery']"))e.textContent="NC";
      if((t==="B"||t==="O")&&e.parentElement&&/Open slot|Also open/i.test(e.parentElement.textContent))e.textContent="+";
    });
  }
  if(document.readyState!=="loading")fix();else document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",fix);
  setTimeout(fix,1500);
})();
</script>
<script>
/* TLL voice sweep v1 (2026-08-23): anti-AI framing retired as marketing; byline claim = "Every byline a real person".
   The chatbot line is injected by a site-level footer script, so rewrite at runtime. */
(function(){
  function sweep(){
    var w=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT),t;
    while(t=w.nextNode()){var s=t.nodeValue;if(!s)continue;var o=s;
      s=s.replace(/\s*·?\s*0 stories by a chatbot/g,"");
      s=s.replace(/Every byline a real name\./g,"Every byline a real person.");
      if(s!==o)t.nodeValue=s;}
  }
  if(document.readyState!=="loading")sweep();else document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",sweep);
  setTimeout(sweep,1500);setTimeout(sweep,4000);
})();
</script>
<script>
/* TLL home search routing v2 (2026-09-23): two faults behind one broken button.
   1. The form had no action, so submitting reloaded the home page with the query stranded in the URL.
      It now goes to /stories, which already filters on ?q=.
   2. Webflow puts every form behind Turnstile bot protection, which left the Search button permanently disabled.
      That is right for the newsletter and submission forms and wrong for a search box: it is a GET navigation and
      collects nothing. Detach this one form from Turnstile and hold its button enabled.
   Submit is handled in the capture phase so Webflow's own form handler never sees the event. */
(function(){
  function wire(){
    var i = document.querySelector('input[name="Search-the-library"]');
    if (!i || !i.form || i.form.__tllRouted) return;
    var f = i.form; f.__tllRouted = 1;
    f.setAttribute('action', '/stories');
    f.setAttribute('method', 'get');
    f.removeAttribute('data-turnstile-sitekey');

    var btn = f.querySelector('input[type=submit],button[type=submit]');
    if (btn) {
      var enable = function(){
        if (btn.disabled) btn.disabled = false;
        if (btn.classList.contains('w-form-loading')) btn.classList.remove('w-form-loading');
      };
      enable();
      try { new MutationObserver(enable).observe(btn, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['disabled','class'] }); } catch (e) {}
    }

    function go(){
      var q = (i.value || '').trim();
      location.href = '/stories' + (q ? '?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q) : '');
    }
    document.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
      if (e.target !== f) return;
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go();
    }, true);
    i.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); go(); } });
  }
  if (document.readyState !== 'loading') wire(); else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', wire);
  setTimeout(wire, 1200);
})();
</script>
